patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Intercom documents a broader use-case set; Freshchat is narrower/specialist.

Intercom documents a broader use-case set; Freshchat is narrower/specialist. Choose Freshchat only if your buying job matches “Freshworks live chat — free up to 10 agents; Growth $19, Pro $49, Enterprise $79 agent/mo ” rather than Intercom's shape. Choose Intercom only if your buying job matches “Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.9” rather than Freshchat's shape. Workflow advantage: Freshchat leans shared coverage; Intercom leans customer-messaging, whatsapp-support. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Intercom documents a broader use-case set; Freshchat is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Freshchat is Freshworks live chat — free up to 10 agents; Growth $19, Pro $49, Enterprise $79 agent/mo annual. Primary live-chat; CS secondary.; Intercom is Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.99/outcome. Primary live-chat; BC + CS secondary..
- Company-size focus: Freshchat (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Intercom (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Freshchat-leaning — vs Intercom-leaning customer-messaging, whatsapp-support, contact-center.
- Researched limits: Freshchat — Full ticketing depth lives in Freshdesk — Freshchat is live-chat primary; Intercom — Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume.

Limitations — Freshchat: Full ticketing depth lives in Freshdesk — Freshchat is live-chat primary; Free plan limited to 10 agents; Intercom: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume; SMS, WhatsApp and Phone are pay-as-you-go add-on channels, not unlimited included.

Poor-fit cases: Freshchat is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Full ticketing depth lives in Freshdesk — Freshchat is live-chat primary · Intercom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume · Avoid Freshchat if you actually need Intercom's motion (Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
